reasons: Rewrote scripts/block-dangerous-git.sh to tokenize commands. It splits shell segments (; && || | & newlines, subshells, $(...), backticks), skips VAR= prefixes and wrappers (env, sudo, xargs, time, timeout and others), recurses into bash -c, sh -c and eval, strips git global options (-C, -c, --git-dir, --work-tree), and matches the subcommand and its flags. Quoted commit messages no longer cause false positives.

Now blocks git -C . push, double-spaced 'git  push', git clean with any force flag (-df, -xfd, --force; dry runs with -n are allowed), git checkout -- . and checkout --force, and git branch --delete --force. It allows git restore --staged . and git commit -m 'avoid git push here'.
Fails closed: exits 2 when jq is missing or the hook input is not valid JSON.
